title: Dirty-worker task results lost baseline metadata
observed: During development, the retained worker manifest included its dirty baseline, but task-result conversion omitted it for nested and main agents. The real CLI regression failed with worker result lost the captured baseline metadata.
expected: The task result and retained manifest carry the same baseline identity for review and integration.

fix.note: Caught before release; the real CLI regression fails before both conversion paths are corrected and passes afterward.
